linesEn: Father. I, Thor, present myself before Your Majesty.
Ah, you're here! Rise, rise. There are no courtiers here; no need for such formality.
Thank you, Father.

linesZhTw: 你。這一陣子國務繁忙，我
們父子兩個也很久沒聚聚了
linesZhCn: 你。这一阵子国务繁忙，我
们父子两个也很久没聚聚了
linesEn: Come closer and let me get a good look at you. Affairs of state have kept me so busy of late...
...that it feels like ages since the two of us sat down together like this.
Indeed! It is rare that our family gets to gather together.
Yes, Mother.

linesZhTw: 經長得這麼高了。大臣和將
領們對你的武藝和能力也讚
linesZhCn: 经长得这么高了。大臣和将
领们对你的武艺和能力也赞
linesEn: Thor, how time flies. You have grown into quite a fine young man.
The ministers and generals have nothing but praise for your martial skill and leadership.

linesZhTw: 譽有加，我想，也該是決定
linesZhCn: 誉有加，我想，也该是决定
linesEn: Because of this, I believe the time has come to decide the succession to the throne.

linesZhTw: 迪恩接任王位，兒臣不勝欣
linesZhCn: 迪恩接任王位，儿臣不胜欣
linesEn: Yes, Father. You must mean my brother Dean will succeed you.
I could not be happier for him.

linesZhTw: 來接任羅特帝亞的王位。』
linesZhCn: 来接任罗特帝亚的王位。』
linesEn: You are mistaken, Thor. It is you I wish to see inherit the throne of Lotedia.
What? I... I am to take the throne?
Yes, Thor. Do you have any doubts regarding my decision?

linesZhTw: 父王，兒臣並未繼承羅特帝
亞王家的血脈，照理來說，
linesZhCn: 父王，儿臣并未继承罗特帝
亚王家的血脉，照理来说，
linesEn: I would not presume, Father. But... but I carry no royal blood of Lotedia in my veins.
By all rights...

linesZhTw: 兒臣以為應該由皇弟迪恩
linesZhCn: 儿臣以为应该由皇弟迪恩
linesEn: ...it should be my brother Dean who inherits the crown...

linesZhTw: 時代。只有強者才能掌握軍
隊、統治國家，維持世界的
linesZhCn: 时代。只有强者才能掌握军
队、统治国家，维持世界的
linesEn: Thor, we live in an era where strength reigns supreme.
Only the strong can command the army, govern the realm, and preserve world peace...

linesZhTw: 和平和人民的福祉。羅特帝
亞需要一個強有力的統治者
我相信你能接替我繼承王位
linesZhCn: 和平和人民的福祉。罗特帝
亚需要一个强有力的统治者
我相信你能接替我继承王位
linesEn: ...and the welfare of our people. Lotedia requires a powerful ruler.
I have every faith that you can succeed me on the throne...
...and indeed, you are the only one who can.
But what about Dean...?

linesZhTw: 個聰明的孩子，可以成為賢
明的君主，但是他長得太文
linesZhCn: 个聪明的孩子，可以成为贤
明的君主，但是他长得太文
linesEn: Dean is not like you. He is a clever boy, and could well become a benevolent ruler.
However, he is far too frail...

linesZhTw: 弱了，無法穿著重甲、統率
大軍在戰場上奔馳。我還記
得當我還是個孩子時所發生
linesZhCn: 弱了，无法穿着重甲、统率
大军在战场上奔驰。我还记
得当我还是个孩子时所发生
linesEn: ...unable to don heavy armor or lead our legions across the battlefield.
I still remember what happened when I was merely a child.

linesZhTw: 的事情，所以…為了羅特帝
亞王族，為了羅特帝亞王國
的人民，我希望你能成為王
linesZhCn: 的事情，所以…为了罗特帝
亚王族，为了罗特帝亚王国
的人民，我希望你能成为王
linesEn: And so... for the royal house of Lotedia, and for the people of our kingdom...
...I ask that you accept the mantle of leadership.
You must become the heir to the throne.

linesZhTw: 們把你當成自己親生的孩子
撫養長大，這件事也是經過
linesZhCn: 们把你当成自己亲生的孩子
抚养长大，这件事也是经过
linesEn: Listen to your father, Thor. All these years, we have raised you as our own flesh and blood.
This decision was made after long and careful deliberation.

linesZhTw: 慎重考慮之後才決定的，希
linesZhCn: 慎重考虑之后才决定的，希
linesEn: Please, my son... won't you accept?
Father... Mother... I...

linesZhTw: 『我就知道你會一時無法接受
這樣吧，三天之後，你再給
我考慮的結果，當然了，我
linesZhCn: 『我就知道你会一时无法接受
这样吧，三天之后，你再给
我考虑的结果，当然了，我
linesEn: I knew this would be hard for you to take in all at once.
Take three days to consider it, and then give me your answer. Though of course...

linesZhTw: 希望能夠聽到肯定的答覆。
linesZhCn: 希望能够听到肯定的答覆。
linesEn: ...I hope to hear a resounding yes.
Go now, and rest.
...Yes, Father. I shall take my leave.

linesZhTw: 躲在這裡打瞌睡，真是一點
linesZhCn: 躲在这里打瞌睡，真是一点
linesEn: Ha! I looked all over for you, only to find you dozing off out here.
That's not like you at all!
What's wrong? You seem completely out of sorts today.
...*sigh*

linesZhTw: 你居然在嘆氣！我看我們得
linesZhCn: 你居然在叹气！我看我们得
linesEn: Hey! Is lightning about to strike? You, sighing?!
All right, you and I need to have a serious talk!
Thor, what on earth happened?
...It's nothing, really.

linesZhTw: 氣的事絕對不會超過十件。
linesZhCn: 气的事绝对不会超过十件。
linesEn: Drop the act! In the whole wide world, there can't be ten things that could make you sigh.
Spill it!
...Father wants me to succeed him to the throne.
Didn't you hear me? Father wants me to take the throne.

linesZhTw: 的？羅特帝亞的准王位繼承
人……這要好好慶祝一下才
linesZhCn: 的？罗特帝亚的准王位继承
人……这要好好庆祝一下才
linesEn: Wait, what?! How is that something to sigh about?
The heir apparent to the kingdom of Lotedia...
This calls for a proper celebration!

linesZhTw: 大，你竟然一點都不瞭解我
linesZhCn: 大，你竟然一点都不瞭解我
linesEn: You idiot! And here I thought you knew me after all these years growing up together!
Huh? What do you mean by that?

linesZhTw: 天待在王城裏哪裡也不能去
還得管理繁瑣的政務、應付
linesZhCn: 天待在王城里哪里也不能去
还得管理繁琐的政务、应付
linesEn: Why would I ever want to be king?!
Trapped in the castle all day, unable to go anywhere, buried under tedious state affairs...

linesZhTw: 囉唆的大臣和官員……那有
linesZhCn: 啰唆的大臣和官员……那有
linesEn: ...having to deal with nagging ministers and petty officials! Where's the fun in that?!
Well, knowing your personality... I suppose you have a point.

linesZhTw: 地去做幾次轟轟烈烈的冒險
絕對不是枯坐在王位上終老
linesZhCn: 地去做几次轰轰烈烈的冒险
绝对不是枯坐在王位上终老
linesEn: Ever since I was a boy, all I wanted was to journey far and wide on grand adventures!
Not wither away on some dreary throne until I'm old and gray!

linesZhTw: 一生！我只是父王的養子，
和羅特帝亞王家沒有血緣關
係，所以我一直以為會由皇
linesZhCn: 一生！我只是父王的养子，
和罗特帝亚王家没有血缘关
系，所以我一直以为会由皇
linesEn: I'm only Father's adopted son. I don't have a drop of royal Lotedian blood in me.
So I always assumed Dean would inherit the crown...

linesZhTw: 弟迪恩繼承王位，我就可以
linesZhCn: 弟迪恩继承王位，我就可以
linesEn: ...and I'd be off the hook to live my own life. Who could've seen this coming... *sigh*
That is quite a predicament. Did you already get forced into agreeing?

linesZhTw: 但是我能說不嗎？這和答應
linesZhCn: 但是我能说不吗？这和答应
linesEn: Father told me to give him my answer in three days, but can I really say no?
It's practically the same as forcing my hand!
Fair point... Though I'm afraid there isn't much I can do to help with that.

linesZhTw: 在就陪我到後山去練劍，痛
快的打上一場之後，也許我
linesZhCn: 在就陪我到后山去练剑，痛
快的打上一场之后，也许我
linesEn: *sigh* If you really want to help, come spar with me in the back hills right now.
A good, fierce clash of swords might be just what I need...
...to clear my head and feel a little better.
Say no more! That's easy enough—let's get going!
